method: Exact md5 join of the 1,137 v2 sequences against centroid_md5 of the 18,172,960 90%-centroids in the local centroids90.parquet. The join key was verified: all 1,137 md5s reproduce as the md5 of the uppercase sequence from sequences.fasta.
note_vs_brief: The brief reports 401 of 1,219 (32.90%) found in the corpus. That join was against all 131 orfs shards, so all 307M ORFs. This join is against the 18.17M 90%-centroids only, so it counts labelled sequences that are themselves centroids. The difference, roughly 280 sequences, are cluster members rather than centroids: they are at least 90% identical to something in a centroid-only pretraining set but never appear in it verbatim.

c60_cut.verdict: effectively free, removes verbatim val/test sequences

c30_cut.verdict: not free, and counterproductive: the 9 clusters are the core PET hydrolase families, so the cut removes the signal the corpus exists to provide
